title: Correct WG1 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must state WG1 = -mg(hB - hA) or equivalent.

title: Correct WG2 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must state WG2 = -mg(hB - hA) or equivalent.

title: Correct Wf1 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must state Wf1 = -f(hB - hA) or equivalent.

title: Correct Wf2 expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must state Wf2 = -f(2hO - hA - hB) or equivalent.

title: Path independence of gravity
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must note that gravity's work is the same for both paths.

title: Path dependence of air resistance
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must note that air resistance's work differs between the two paths.

title: No potential energy for air resistance
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must connect path dependence to the absence of a potential energy concept for air resistance.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the sign (negative for upward displacement against force) is incorrect for any work calculation.

title: Incorrect displacement for Wf2
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the total displacement for air resistance in the round trip is not correctly summed (e.g., ignoring the return leg).
